text: work must be an absolute path under /home/agent, such as /home/agent/work.
/home/agent/work is also where payments mounts. Give one of them another path.
/home/agent/work/api is inside /home/agent/work, where payments mounts. Two mounts can't nest.
payments uses Anthropic API and docs uses Bedrock. A run uses one model provider, so remove one of them.
payments and docs use different base images. A run uses one image, so remove one of them.
payments uses Azure DevOps organisation acme and docs uses globex. A run signs in to one Azure DevOps organisation, so remove one of them.
